units.en: When setting up a game of HOIIV, players are able to modify specific elements of the game's difficulty settings by clicking the ⟦0⟧ button.
Custom Game Rules
⟦0⟧ Most modifications to these game rules will result in ⟦1⟧ being disabled.
Note:
achievements
Major Nation Buffs

Major Nation Buffs allow the player to increase the strength of HOIV's major nations, which include: ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, the ⟦4⟧, the ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ (along with ⟦7⟧ and ⟦8⟧), and China (both the ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧). These buffs are implemented via sliders, which confer powerful bonuses on the selected country (countries) when the slider is maxed out, with the buffs being weaker if the slider is less than max (if slider is halfway, 50% of buffs get applied).
Germany
Italy
Soviet Union
France
United Kingdom
United States
Japan
Mengkukuo
Manchukuo
Republic of China
Communist China
The full list of buffs is available ⟦0⟧.
here
Increasing the strength of any of these major nations will disable achievements.
Foreign Policy
Wargoals
Players can determine how limited countries are in generating wargoals.
Option
Description
Achievements enabled?
Always Free
Wargoals are unrestricted for any ideology at any World Tension.
Limited
Wargoal generation is limited by ideologies and World Tension limits.
Free at 25% World Tension
Wargoal generation is disabled below 25% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
Free at 50% World Tension
Wargoal generation is disabled below 50% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
Free at 75% World Tension
Wargoal generation is disabled below 75% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
Free at 100% World Tension
Wargoal generation is disabled below 100% World Tension, but is available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
Focuses Only
Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events, and decisions.
Focuses Only (until 1938)
Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events, and decisions, until 1938.
Focuses Only (until 1939)
Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events, and decisions, until 1939.
Focuses Only (until 1940)
Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events, and decisions, until 1940.
Military Access and Docking Rights
Players can determine how limited countries are in granting ⟦0⟧.
military and docking rights
Free
Countries can gain military access and docking rights from any other country.
Same Ideology Only
Countries can gain military access and docking rights from countries that share the same ruling ideology.
Blocked
Countries can never gain military access and docking rights from any other country outside of a faction.
Release Nations
Players can determine whether countries can release nations that are within their territory.
Countries may always release nations unless specifically prevented.
Only While at Peace
Countries may only release nations while at peace.
Countries can never release nations.
Production Licenses
Players can determine how limited countries are in giving/receiving ⟦0⟧.
production licenses
Countries may acquire production licenses from any country.
Countries may only acquire production licenses from countries that share the same ruling ideology.
Same Faction Only
Countries may only acquire production licenses from countries in the same faction.
Countries may never acquire production licenses outside of special decisions and events.
Lend Lease
Players can determine how limited countries are in sending ⟦0⟧.
lend-lease
Countries may lend-lease equipment to anyone at any World Tension level.
Lend-Lease is limited by World Tension and ideology rules.
Countries may only lend-lease equipment to countries of the same ruling ideology.
Countries may only lend-lease equipment to countries in the same faction.
Countries may never lend-lease equipment to any other country.
Volunteers
Players can determine how limited countries are in sending volunteers.
Countries may send volunteers to any country regardless of World Tension.
Sending volunteers is restricted by World Tension and ideology rules.
Countries may only send volunteers to countries that share the same ruling ideology.
Countries may never send volunteers to any country.
Guarantee Independence
Players can determine whether countries can ⟦0⟧ of other nations.
guarantee the independence
The independence of any country can be guaranteed at any time, regardless of World Tension.
Issuing a guarantee of independence is restricted by World Tension and ideology.
Countries can only guarantee countries that share their ruling ideology.
Countries can never guarantee other countries. This does not affect guarantees that exist at the start of the game or which are issued through national focuses.
Revoke Guarantees
Players can determine whether countries can revoke guarantees of independence.
Allowed
Guarantees of Independence can be revoked.
Guarantees of Independence can never be revoked outside of national focuses.
Leave Faction
Players can determine whether faction members can leave their ⟦0⟧.
faction
Fully sovereign countries may leave a faction while at peace.
Countries may not leave a faction except through national focuses and events.
Kick From Faction
Players can determine whether faction leaders can kick members from their faction.
The leader of a faction may kick any country from the faction.
The leader of a faction may not kick any member of the faction.
Take Over Faction Leadership
Players can determine whether countries can take control of a faction when certain conditions are met.
Countries may take over faction leadership if they fulfill the criteria.
Countries may not take over faction leadership.
Covert Actions
Coups
Players may modify the situations in which ⟦0⟧ are allowed.
coups
Countries may prepare and execute coups freely.
Against AI Only
Countries may only prepare and execute coups against nations not played by a human.
Countries may not prepare or execute coups in any nation.
Boosting Party Popularity
Players may modify the situations in which boosting ⟦0⟧ is allowed.
party popularity
Countries may boost party popularity in any other country.
Countries may only boost party popularity in countries not played by a human.
Against Player Only
Countries may only boost party popularity in countries with a human player.
Countries may not boost party popularity in any country.
Gameplay Rules
Paradrops

Players may allow or block the ability of ⟦0⟧ divisions to use their ability to be dropped into provinces via aircraft. However, this does not disable the ability to recruit and deploy paratrooper divisions.
paratrooper
Countries may execute parachute drops freely.
Countries may not execute parachute drops under any circumstances. Paratrooper divisions may still be recruited, but will not be able to execute airborne attacks.
Maximum Fort Level

Players can set the highest level of ⟦0⟧ (both land and coastal) that can be built manually. The setting may be left alone (allowing for forts up to Level 10), or set anywhere between Level 1 and Level 9. However, pre-existing forts, and relevant national focuses, decisions, and events are not constrained by this setting.
forts
Normal
Countries may construct land and coastal forts according to normal restrictions.
Level 1

Countries may only build up land and coastal forts to the selected level. Fortifications present at the start of the game are not affected by this. Buildings granted from national focuses, decisions and events may exceed the selected level.
Level 9
Scorched Earth
Disallows use of Scorched Earth in State Menus.
Countries may use Scorch Earth freely.
Countries may not use Scorch Earth under any circumstances.
AI Behavior

Players wishing to have a different HOIV experience can modify the behavior of several AI nations. These options include ensuring historical accuracy or prompting countries to pursue alternative paths.
Some nations are only available for modification upon purchase of certain DLC. These requirements are marked by an icon next to the name of the nation.
Default
The AI will make decisions based on other gameplay settings, such as the option to force historical focuses and other gameplay scenarios. This is the same behavior as in version 1.5 and earlier.
Fascist
The German AI will remain fascist and attempt to take over Europe by going down ⟦0⟧ in the national focus tree.
the relevant path
Democratic
The German AI will attempt to create a constitutional monarchy by going down ⟦0⟧ in the national focus tree.
the relevant paths
Restore the Kaiser
The German AI will attempt to return the Kaiser to the throne by going down ⟦0⟧ in the national focus tree.
Alternative Fascism
The German AI will attempt to replace Hitler with one the members of the Inner Circle, heed von Neurath's concerns and attempt to enforce its New World Order.
Dictatorship of the Proletariat
The German AI will attempt to overthrow the Nazis, and bring the communist revolution to Germany. They will then attempt to establish a dictatorship of the proletariat.
Revive the Spartacus League

The German AI will attempt to overthrow the Nazis, and bring the communist revolution to Germany. They will then attempt to install a more democratic socialist regime under the new Spartacus League, and spread the communist revolutionary wildfire throughout Europe.
Random
The AI will randomly decide on a game plan at the start of the game and attempt to execute it.
Historical
The Soviet AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
Left Opposition
The Soviet AI will try to re-instate the Left Opposition and re-start the permanent revolution, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
Left Opposition Cooperative

The Soviet AI will try to re-instate the Left Opposition and include other opposition groups in the party as well as re-start the permanent revolution, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree. The goal for the AI is to form the Supreme Soviet.
Right Opposition
The Soviet AI will try to put the Right Opposition into power, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
Right Opposition Cooperative

The Soviet AI will try to put the Right Opposition into power and include other opposition groups in the party, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree. The goal for the AI is to form the Supreme Soviet.
Tsarist Exiles
The Soviet AI will expell the Communists through civil war, and reinstate Tsarist Russia, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
Fascist Exiles
The Soviet AI will expell the Communists through civil war, and establish a fascist government, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
The Red Sun Rises
The Japanese AI will attempt to turn communist and support other communist regimes in Asia by going down ⟦0⟧ in the national focus tree.
The Labor-Farmer Faction Ascendant
The Japanese AI will attempt to turn communist and install a Ronoha-led government, leading a crusade against imperialism in Asia by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
The Kodoha Faction Victorious
The Japanese AI will attempt to strike north against the Soviet Union and make common cause with the Axis by going down ⟦0⟧ in the national focus tree.
A Clean Democracy
The Japanese AI will attempt to reform into a democracy by going down ⟦0⟧ in the focus tree.
Imperial Rule Assistance Association
The Japanese AI will pursue its historical path and attempt to strike south against the western allies by going down ⟦0⟧ in the national focus tree.
Fascist - Historical
The Italian AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
Alternative Fascist - Italo Balbo
The Italian AI will attempt to oust Mussolini from power, and install Italo Balbo instead to seek an independent path forward.
Alternative Fascist - Dino Grandi
The Italian AI will attempt to oust Mussolini from power, and install Dino Grandi instead to seek to strengthen ties with the allies.
Monarchist - Roman Empire
King Vittorio Emanuele will lead Italy towards an absolute monarchy, trying to achieve Mare Nostrum and reforming the Roman Empire.
Christian Democracy

King Vittorio Emanuele will depose Mussolini, attempt to form an independent faction and lead Italy towards a constitutional monarchy favoring the Christian Democratic party, led by Alcide de Gasperi.
Italian Communism
Italian anti-fascists will join forces to overthrow the fascist regime by force, forming a communist government, abolishing the colonies and seeking to join the Comintern
Italian Socialism
Italian anti-fascists will join forces to overthrow the fascist regime by force, forming a social-democratic government and seeking to form a Confederation with former colonies in Africa.
Communist
The French AI will attempt to turn communist and join the Comintern by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
Democratic - Historical
The French AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
Democratic - Alternate
The French AI will attempt to form the Little Entente to contain Germany. Should Czechoslovakia create that faction, they will join it instead.
The French AI will attempt to turn fascist and make common cause with a fascist Germany, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
Monarchist: House of Orléan
The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Orléanist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
Monarchist: House of Bourbon
The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Legitimist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
Monarchist: House of Bonapart
The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Bonapartist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
Poland
The Polish AI will attempt to come to an understanding with the USSR to protect itself against aggression, by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
The Polish AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
The Polish AI will attempt to restore democracy and join the Allies.
The Polish AI will attempt to reconcile with Germany for protection, by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
Fascist: Falangist International
The Polish AI will attempt to embrace Falangism and stand against Germany.
Monarchist: House of Wettin
The Polish AI will crown Friedrich Christian as king and attempt to restore the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
Monarchist: House of Hohenzollern
The Polish AI will crown a Hohenzollern as king and attempt to form a union with Romania.
Monarchist: House of Habsburg
